properties.description: Line 5 past Dhamankar Naka as MMRDA's civil tenders of Oct 2026 draw it (CA-317, CA-318, CA-314). The route is traced from the key plan in the tender drawings (MMRDA-MML-05-MTR-GAD-TD-1000, CA-314 Volume V), placed on the map by fitting its Line 12 to MMRDA's Line 12 file and its route to the six stations whose coordinates the CA-317 and CA-318 plan sheets print (UTM 43N, WGS84). Those six stations are within 6 m of the traced line and within 6 m of the main road in OpenStreetMap. Other stations are placed by their tender chainage along the line (good to about 50 m). Built by scripts/line5-tenders/assemble.py.
